modern_card.name: Shinato, King of a Higher Plane

changes.historical_text: This card can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Shinato's Ark". You must also Tribute monsters whose total Levels equal 8 or more from the field or your hand. When this card destroys a Defense Position monster and sends it to the Graveyard as a result of battle, inflict damage to your opponent's Life Points equal to the original ATK of the destroyed monster.
changes.modern_text: This card can only be Ritual Summoned with the Ritual Spell Card, "Shinato's Ark". You must also Tribute monsters whose total Levels equal 8 or more from the field or your hand. When this card destroys a Defense Position monster and sends it to the Graveyard as a result of battle, inflict damage to your opponent's Life Points equal to the original ATK of the destroyed monster.
changes.summary: No behavioural or textual difference: the goat variant's script differs from the modern script by exactly one line, the absence of `s.listed_names={60365591}` ('Shinato's Ark'), which is card-name reference metadata consulted by other cards' name lookups and never touched during resolution. The damage trigger is identical on both sides (EVENT_BATTLE_DESTROYING, the same s.damcon Defense-Position battle check, and s.damtg inflicting the destroyed monster's GetBaseAttack). The goat cdb text and the pinned modern cards.cdb text are byte-identical and both match lineage v1 (DR1-EN178) exactly.

review.notes: Two upstream codes appear in the packet, but only one is a historical TCG variant. 153000018 (cards-unofficial.cdb, 'Shinato, King of a Higher Plane (Deck Master)', scripted by Larry126) is a Deck Master-format card: its script returns immediately unless the DeckMaster module is loaded, it adds two Deck Master abilities (LP recovery on opponent damage, and a destruction-replacement that banishes itself outside the Duel), and its monster effect inflicts damage equal to half the opponent's LP rather than the destroyed monster's original ATK. It is not a period variant of this record and is not eligible as a baseline; baseline is the goat entry 504700148. The two codes are not within +/-10 but they are also not an upstream duplication of the same card, so no escalation flag - recorded here so the choice is auditable. Trailing lineage version v2 (SBC2-ENI01, Speed Duel: Battle City Finals, 2024-12-13) is a PSCT rewrite that the pinned modern cards.cdb has NOT adopted (the pinned modern text is still lineage v1), so it is not recorded as a change. Upstream ships the goat entry for reference-list parity; behaviour is identical, hence upstream-variant-cosmetic.
